name: Energy
overview: Scripture reveals that true energy and strength come from the everlasting God, who never grows weary or faint, unlike man whose power can fail (Isaiah 40:28; Deuteronomy 32:36). Believers are called to seek God's kingdom first and abide in His presence to receive spiritual vitality and protection (Matthew 6:33; Psalms 91:1). Prayer and watchfulness are essential practices to sustain this spiritual energy, enabling believers to stand firm before Christ (Luke 21:36). Ultimately, God's greatness surpasses human strength, underscoring our dependence on His divine power rather than any human or mystical source (Job 33:12).
